items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: Add an oil change if coolant got into the oil.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping, harsh shifts or failure
items.job: Replace pressure control solenoid, or rebuild/replace the transaxle
items.note: A solenoid-only repair is at the low end; a remanufactured transaxle is at the high end. Owners report $1,200–$1,400 for rebuilds.

items.t: Oil can drip onto the exhaust manifold and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Ignition key can be bumped out of Run (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Ignition switch can turn off while driving (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: No-start with flashing security light (Passlock)
items.job: Diagnose and repair Passlock sensor or ignition lock cylinder wiring
items.note: Owners report about $800 on average when parts are replaced at a dealer.

items.t: Turn signals work only some of the time
items.note: If the multifunction switch on the column is at fault, parts cost more.

items.t: ABS and traction control lights on
items.job: Replace front wheel speed sensor or repair sensor wiring
items.note: On some years the sensor is built into the hub bearing, which raises the parts cost.

items.t: Front wheel bearing hum or grinding
items.job: Replace front hub bearing assembly (one side)

items.t: Power window drops or stops working
items.job: Replace window regulator (with motor if needed)

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit or fuel pump module
items.note: The tank has to be lowered.

items.t: Clunk from the steering when turning
items.job: Lubricate or replace intermediate steering shaft
items.note: Lubrication alone often fixes it for a while.

items.t: Power steering cooler line or hose leak
items.job: Replace power steering cooler line or hose
items.note: Ask a dealer if GM campaign 09132 still applies.

items.t: Brakes feel delayed on wet roads (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Rough idle and misfire from clogged fuel injectors
items.note: Cleaning is at the low end; a new injector set at the high end.

items.t: Timing belt failure (3.4L DOHC)
items.note: If valves were damaged, cylinder head work costs far more.

items.t: A/C blows warm
items.note: Finding and fixing a small leak costs much less.

items.t: Engine stalls or dies while driving
items.job: Replace camshaft or crankshaft position sensor
items.note: If wiring or the engine computer is at fault, cost rises.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket leak (3.5L and 3.9L)
Oil consumption (5.3L V8)
items.job: Oil consumption test and PCV / valley cover repair
items.note: If the piston rings are worn, engine repair costs much more.

items.t: Clicking behind the dashboard
items.job: Replace HVAC mode or blend door actuator

items.t: Rusted-out muffler and exhaust pipes
Repeat oil pan leak
Instrument cluster gauges act up
Passenger airbag may be missing a check pin (recall)
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.
